positive.description: P1 — Create a fresh private Mac mini draft in the dedicated reviewer account, then confirm and activate only after a separate approval turn. Choose a new REVIEW-NEW run label each time; do not reuse the pre-seeded sample or an old cancelled contact exchange. Separate follow-up after inspecting the actual draft: I have reviewed this draft and the separate synthetic contact details. They are correct. Confirm and activate this intent for matching, while keeping it off the public feed.
positive.prompt: Please use English throughout. Choose a fresh unique label starting REVIEW-NEW for this fictional review run and show it to me. Create a private draft for one used M2 Mac mini with 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, working condition and proof of purchase. Budget up to SGD 600, collection in Singapore, no rush. This is synthetic review data: seek only compatible synthetic review samples, not real transactions. Store review-buyer@example.com separately as my synthetic private contact, never in business fields. Keep the listing off the public feed. Show the actual saved draft and wait for my approval before activating it.
positive.tools_triggered: ingest_intent, get_intent, confirm_intent, activate_intent; set_intent_contact if necessary
positive.expected_behavior: Keep contact data separate. Show actual draft and unknown fields. Wait for follow-up approval. Activate the same ID, keep visibility private, use idempotent writes and bounded retries without duplicates.

positive.description: P2 — Read actual matches for the new active buyer intention from P1. A separate, operator-controlled demo seller already has an active private offer: M2 Mac mini, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, proof of purchase, normal wear, SGD 550, Singapore collection. Its business description contains REVIEW-20261022-SG-MINI-PENDING-SELLER. The reviewer does not need to sign in as that seller. Confirm the actual counterpart ID before P3. If matching is still running, report that state and retry the read after it finishes; never invent a match.
positive.prompt: Show the latest matches for the new REVIEW-NEW Mac mini intent we created and activated in P1. Find the synthetic seller whose description contains REVIEW-20261022-SG-MINI-PENDING-SELLER. Compare model, memory, storage, price and location using only returned data. Explain unknown or unverified information. Do not contact anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned IDs and business summaries. Distinguish unknown/unverified fields and empty results. Do not reveal counterpart contacts or invoke write/exchange tools.

positive.description: P3 — Buyer requests contact exchange only for the exact pre-seeded synthetic seller match identified in P2. The seller has not approved it. Use the current reviewed private contact version. Each test run starts with a new P1 buyer intent so previous cancellations are not reused.
positive.prompt: For the synthetic REVIEW-20261022-SG-MINI-PENDING-SELLER match we just reviewed, I agree to share my reviewed synthetic contact, review-buyer@example.com, only if that demo seller also agrees. Request contact exchange for this match only. Do not contact any other match.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual match ID and reviewed current contact version. With no reverse consent, report pending and withhold seller contact. Do not mark either intent fulfilled.

positive.description: P4 — Withdraw the pending buyer request created in P3 and verify that private contacts remain unavailable. This is independently runnable by the reviewer account and does not require a second mailbox, operator intervention or pre-approved expiring consent. Read the current exchange and its row_version before cancelling.
positive.prompt: Cancel the pending contact exchange I requested in P3 for this new REVIEW-NEW Mac mini intent. Check the resulting status and confirm that seller contact details are unavailable. Keep both listings unchanged. Do not approve on behalf of the seller or create another request.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the existing P3 exchange and read its current row_version. Cancel only the buyer-owned pending request using expected_row_version. Verify status=cancelled and no counterpart contact disclosure. Preserve both intention lifecycles and do not claim deletion or transaction completion. On a version conflict, read the current state before deciding whether cancellation is still applicable.

positive.description: P5 — Pause only the new buyer intention created in P1, preserving its record. Do not pause the pre-seeded buyer or seller samples. For another review run, create a fresh P1 intent; do not reuse the cancelled P3 exchange.
positive.prompt: Pause matching for the new REVIEW-NEW Mac mini intent we created in P1. Keep the record for later. Leave the pre-seeded demo samples unchanged. Do not close it, mark it completed, or claim its data has been deleted.
positive.expected_behavior: Use pause, not close or fulfill. Confirm returned paused lifecycle. Do not claim deletion or revocation of previously viewed information.
